1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea de hasta 75 cm de longitud, de tallos frágiles, hojas ovaladas, moradas por la cara inferior y verde por la superior; se le atribuyen propiedades medicinales. (Commelinaceae; Commelina longicaulis).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Herbaceous plant of up to 75 cm in length, with fragile stems, oval-shaped leaves that are purple on the lower surface and green on the upper surface; medicinal properties are attributed to it (Commelinaceae; Commelina longicaulis).
